items.title: Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2022
items.q: So I knew like Obama and Clinton, you know we had someone that actually got it

ctx.x: The archives, yeah. © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-

Yeah. We were really thrilled that, and surprised, that at a time when he may have had a vote that could save democracy in America he — that was canceled for a couple of days so he came up and Richard Blumenthal did the ribbon cutting. Our state senator. And when we met him I just, you know, you don’t know what his background is. The first thing he says, he says, “We grew up in a classical household” the Blumenthal household, “and my brother and I, our big rebellion is we’d go out and buy your dad’s records.” So…

Well the fact that you’re doing this and you have the Brubeck News going on, which I just read this morning, it’s terrific and I thank you for doing it. It’s really important. And even though it was delayed for a year and a half I guess, it’s all good.
